description: Runs firmware in simulation and asserts that specific text or regex patterns appear on UART. Ideal for automated unit & integration testing in a Red-Green-Refactor agent loop.

appBin.description: Direct path to the application binary (.bin).

board.description: Board model: S3 'atech14' (default), 'waveshare-lcd4b', 'waveshare-amoled18-v2', 'waveshare-cam'; C6 'waveshare-c6-lcd147'; ESP32 'ttgo-tdisplay', 'esp32dev-loopback'; 'none' for a bare module. Omit on the C3, which has no boards. See sim_list_boards.

bootloaderBin.description: Direct path to bootloader.bin (needed with appBin for a real ROM boot).

chip.description: Target chip family. Default is s3 (ESP32-S3).

events.description: Optional interaction events before checking patterns.

data.description: serial: text into the USB-Serial/JTAG console. uart: one line into the UART receive FIFO.

durationMs.description: press: how long the button is held (e.g. 150).

target.description: press/release: button name for the board ('btn1', 'btn2', 'sw', 'boot', 'right') or a GPIO number.

time.description: Emulated second when the event fires (e.g. 1.5).

maxSeconds.description: Max emulated seconds to wait for patterns (default 10).

ordered.description: Whether patterns must appear in exact chronological sequence (default: true).

patterns.description: Expected console output. Plain text matches as a substring of a line ("Counter: 5"); write a regular expression between slashes ("/Counter: \\d+/", "/wifi.*connected/i").

projectDir.description: Path to the ESP-IDF project root or build folder. If omitted, uses current working directory.

ptableBin.description: Direct path to partition-table.bin (needed with appBin for a real ROM boot).

wifi.description: Attach a virtual access point with DHCP/DNS/NAT. Spec like 'ssid=demo,psk=secret' (keys: ssid, psk, chan, bssid), or a bare SSID for an open network. Station gets 10.0.2.15.

name: sim_expect
